question: Which one among the following is NOT a land-based ballistic missile?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhanush**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Dhanush ballistic missile:

 
 
• Type: It is a short-range, ship-launched ballistic missile (ShLBM) developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) of India.
 
• Specifications:
 
• Single-stage, liquid-fueled missile.
 
• Range: Approximately 350 kilometers.
 
• Payload: Can carry up to 500 kilograms.
 
• Warhead: Capable of car
